ui.statecraft.gov.effect.admin_leader: Assign the required citizenship and transfer this leadership office. Existing affected leadership must still be transferred first.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.alliance_accept: Accept this alliance and end competing pending alliance offers between the same nations. No money moves.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.alliance_break: End the alliance. Any existing binding truce remains in force.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.alliance_propos: Offer an alliance for counterparty acceptance. No relationship changes until it is accepted.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.allocate: Allocate existing national land without a claim fee or treasury balance transfer. Public title and future sale proceeds follow the most-specific government; changed public titles lose old permits. Private owners and their permits remain intact. Changing a state clears an incompatible city.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.autoclaim: Change automatic claiming for your nation. No claim or payment happens now; every movement rechecks current national authority, adjacency, funds and the fee. New claims have no state or city assignment.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.bill_cancel: Cancel this bill. Cancelling a treaty ballot also ends its pending treaty without settlement.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.bill_override: Open a new frozen-electorate override ballot. A successful supermajority automatically enacts the bill.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.bill_propose: Introduce a national bill for debate. No policy changes or money transfers happen now; amendments use the stricter whole-electorate threshold.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.bill_revise: Replace this bill's editable terms and restart the full debate period.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.bill_sign: Enact this retained bill. Mechanical national settings update now; roleplay laws record text only and national taxes do not inherit locally.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.bill_veto: Veto this passed bill and open the override decision window. No policy is enacted.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.bill_vote: Record your one ballot on these retained terms. A treaty can settle only after both legislatures approve; this vote itself transfers no money or land.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.bypass: Change your explicit protection bypass. It remains valid only while you are currently an operator.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.candidate: Register as a candidate and pay the current nonrefundable registration fee now.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.candidate_withd: Withdraw this candidacy. Any registration fee remains nonrefundable.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.claim: Claim the selected unowned chunks for the nation, with no state or city assignment. The actor pays one atomic batch of claim fees to the nation treasury.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.company_cancel: Cancel this shareholder proposal without applying its proposed effects.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.company_create: Create the company, appoint you as manager/member and issue its entire fixed share supply to you. The incorporation fee is paid now.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.company_disband: Dissolve the company and its invitations only after balances, property, shares and active obligations permit deletion.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.company_execute: Enact the approved shareholder decision now. Dividends use current holdings with exact cent allocation; all external financial guards still apply.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.company_invite: Create or renew an employment invitation. Accepting employment does not grant shares.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.company_join: Join the company's employment roster without receiving management authority or equity.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.company_leave: Remove employment and company-office permissions. Existing shares and share reservations remain owned by that player.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.company_officer: Change this member's company treasury-management authority without changing equity.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.company_owner: Transfer administrative company ownership, not shares or private titles.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.company_propose: Open a share-weighted ballot, freezing current holdings for voting only. No payment happens now; approved dividends use holdings at execution, not that frozen electorate.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.company_vote: Record one vote with the shares fixed when the ballot opened. Current share transfers cannot duplicate its voting weight.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.contract_award: Fund this contract's escrow now and lock the accepted bidder and payee. The contractor is not paid until independent completion approval.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.contract_bid: Submit or replace your bid. No payment happens now: the issuer funds escrow at award and the fixed payee receives it only after completion approval.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.contract_cancel: Cancel this active contract, refund escrow only to its issuing government and release its reservations.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.contract_comple: Approve the submitted work, pay the original accepted payee from escrow and release the contract's chunk reservations.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.contract_create: Reserve the selected government-owned chunks and open bidding. No payment occurs until an independently approved award.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.contract_return: Return work for correction without changing the award, original payee or escrow.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.contract_review: Close bidding and start the bid-review window. No award or payment is made.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.contract_submit: Submit work for independent government review. Escrow is unchanged and no payout happens now.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.contract_withdr: Remove your unawarded bid. No escrow or payment is affected.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.disband: Permanently remove the selected government scope and memberships. State/city allocations must already be cleared; their deletion never unclaims land. Only explicit nation cascade removes its unencumbered public claims. Private titles block national deletion, including operator deletion.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.election_admin: Operator action: %s. Closing applies the current valid result; cancellation clears the ballot without refunding candidate fees.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.election_vote: Record your one ballot for this candidate. The ballot is retained even if you later leave the nation.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.emergency: Temporarily overlay this national policy without replacing its permanent setting or law. Cooldown survives rescission.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.force_unclaim: Remove this claim and title with explicit operator authority, bypassing adjacency but never financial or workflow locks.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.government_crea: Create the government, assign its leader and grant the required membership. Creation fees are paid now.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.invitation_remo: Remove this live invitation without changing existing memberships.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.invite: Create or renew an invitation and notify the invitee. Citizenship changes only after acceptance.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.join: Join this government while preserving valid ancestor citizenship. No tax inheritance is introduced.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.leader: Transfer this leadership office and treasury authority. Private titles and equity do not change.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.leave: Remove the selected citizenship and descendant memberships and offices. Ancestor citizenship and offices remain intact. Automatic claiming ends only when national citizenship is removed.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.mail_delete: Delete matching inbox/sent copies from this mailbox only. Other owners' copies are not removed.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.mail_read: Open this authorized message and mark its selected mailbox copy read. Reviewing this action does not mark it read.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.mail_reply: Send a new reply to this retained sender, using the currently authorized personal or official mailbox.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.mail_send: Deliver this message and save the sender's copy. Mail retention may remove the oldest copies independently.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.metadata: Update descriptive metadata; names remain unique and no scripts or URLs are executed.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.officer: Change this official roster and its scoped descendant-management authority.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.peace_accept_pe: Accept the immutable proposal and introduce both ratification bills. No money or land moves now.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.peace_propose: Propose these monetary and territorial terms and reserve selected claims. No payment or transfer happens until acceptance and any required ratification.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.peace_settle: Settle all monetary terms atomically, then transfer national ownership and negotiated allocations of existing public claims. Public title follows the destination, old public permits clear, war ends and the binding truce begins.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.permit: Replace this player's explicit non-PvP permissions on this private title. Permits never override PvP rules.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.policy: Update this local override. Tax rates remain independent at each level; active emergency overlays may temporarily take precedence.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.property_owner: Reassign only this private title and clear prior permits. Political city/state/nation and improvements remain unchanged.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.property_reassi: Explicitly reassign national ownership and optional state/city allocations, bypassing adjacency but not obligations. Public title follows the destination. Private owners and their permits are preserved.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.query: Inspect authorized information. The eventual command may perform ordinary scheduled maintenance; this review does not.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.repair: Apply only safe integrity cleanup and retention. Leadership, private titles, shares and financial obligations are never guessed or discarded to force a clean audit.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.rescind: Remove the current emergency overlay and reveal the permanent settings underneath it. Cooldown remains in force.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.shares: Transfer these unreserved shares without moving money or changing employment/management authority.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.treaty_cancel: Conclude this proposal without payment or territorial settlement and cancel its outstanding ratification bills.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.unclaim: Remove the selected national claims, titles, improvements and permits. National and private-title authority, connectivity and every financial/workflow commitment must permit the entire batch.
ui.statecraft.gov.effect.war: Declare war, supersede pending alliances and apply the configured wartime access/PvP rules. No money or territory transfers now.
